findings.title: DNS Service Detected
findings.description: Publicly accessible or misconfigured DNS servers can be leveraged in DNS amplification attacks.
findings.remediation: Ensure DNS recursion is restricted to trusted internal clients only.

findings.title: Unencrypted HTTP Service Exposed
findings.description: Web traffic is transmitted in plaintext without TLS encryption.
findings.remediation: Implement TLS/SSL certificates and configure an automatic 301 redirect to HTTPS (Port 443).
